lines.text: Walk by the Spirit and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.
Those led by the Spirit are not under the law, and the acts of the flesh are obvious.
Those who practice idolatry, sorcery, hatred and rage will not inherit the kingdom of God.
The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, courage, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control.
Those who belong to Christ Jesus have buried the flesh, and Paul says not to become conceited.
